resources.string: Izhevsk guide: bars, cinemas and theaters. Find your perfect spot to relax quickly and easily.
Developer: Damir Murzakhmetov\nStudent of group B23-191-3
The armory capital of Russia, a city of labor glory and the birthplace of the legendary Kalashnikov rifle.
Burger club with signature burgers, cocktails, and hookahs.

Located at Clubnaya St, 24. Known for its original menu with unusual dish names, tasty burgers like \"Bloody Woody\", beer cocktails, and board games. Suitable for groups of 70–100 people, delivery available.
Beer bar with American cuisine and snacks, average check 400 RUB.
Addresses: Clubnaya St, 47a or Pushkinskaya St, 268G. A place to meet friends for beer, English breakfast, Tom Yum, fries, and grilled dishes. Open late (until 02:00), up to 100 seats.
Bar with American, German, and Russian cuisine.
Located at Borodina St, 2a. Open late, offering international style drinks and dishes, perfect for evening relaxation.
Address: Svobody St, 173. Table booking, wine list, sports broadcasts, dance floor, 50–100 seats. Menu includes soups, burritos, beer, cocktails, and snacks; live concerts on weekends.
Family cinema with soft seats and affordable prices.
Address: Baranova St, 87, Matrix Mall, 3rd floor. Multiplex with group halls, VIP sofas, and accessible seats; open 10:00–03:00, free parking.
Address: Shiroky lane, 53, Sigma Mall. JBL 7.1 sound, digital projectors, ergonomic seats; cafe, bike parking, discounts; open 10:00–03:00.
Address: Petrova St, 29, Petrovsky Mall. Large 12x5 m screen in Hall 4 (223 seats), disabled access, 1000 parking spaces; modern technologies.
Address: Karla Marksa St, 242 (Central Square). Equipped with Christie and Dolby Digital, shows blockbusters; historic venue since the 80s.
Dramatic theatre with a modern building.
Address: Maksima Gorkogo St, 71. Opened in 1935, offers high-art performances and concerts; stable troupe, variety of genres.
Opera and ballet theatre with 830 seats.
Address: Pushkinskaya St, 221. Repertoire: Tchaikovsky classics (Swan Lake, Eugene Onegin), Verdi, Adam; operettas, musicals; in the new building since 1984.
Puppet theatre for children and adults.
Address: Lomonosova St, 9 (Gogol Boulevard). Since 1935, fairytale building since 1980; performances for all ages, festivals; boxes, seats for children and disabled.
Address: Militsionnaya St. Performances based on classics and modern plays for adults/children; awards, social themes. Located opposite Oktyabrsky Square.
